description: Defines the PlaylistItem class which manages the state and metadata of a media item in a media routing application, including status, position, duration, and remote identifiers.

classes.name: PlaylistItem
classes.description: Represents a media item with its current playback status and metadata, providing methods to update and retrieve its state.

methods.name: PlaylistItem
methods.description: Constructor initializing a PlaylistItem with session ID, item ID, URI, MIME type, and update receiver, setting the timestamp.

methods.name: setRemoteItemId
methods.description: Sets the remote item ID for the playlist item.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Updates the playback state of the media item.

methods.name: setTimestamp
methods.description: Updates the timestamp of the last status change.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration of the media content.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Returns the session ID associated with the playlist item.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the media item.

methods.name: getUpdateReceiver
methods.description: Returns the PendingIntent used for updates.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last status update.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Builds and returns a MediaItemStatus object representing current state.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the playlist item, including session ID, item ID, remote ID, state, and URI.
